directSuspect.currentBehavior: A direct SUSPECT action is normalized to OBSERVE and mutates the input action.
directSuspect.v2Candidate: Define SUSPECT as a first-class non-terminal command, or remove it explicitly; never silently reinterpret it.

autoKill240.currentBehavior: No auto-kill at exactly 240 seconds; the 240 mark fires at 239 seconds or below.
autoKill240.v2Candidate: Keep the strict boundary only if product confirms it, and encode it as an explicit threshold policy.

autoKill60.currentBehavior: No auto-kill at exactly 60 seconds; the 60 mark fires at 59 seconds or below.
autoKill60.v2Candidate: Keep the strict boundary only if product confirms it, and encode it as an explicit threshold policy.

missingThreatTarget.currentBehavior: core applyAction returns ok:true with a system dialogue, while the Telegram application rejects the same request with ok:false.
missingThreatTarget.v2Candidate: Canonical command validation returns a typed rejection; transport maps it without changing semantics.

timerFloor.currentBehavior: One millisecond after start reports 419 seconds because the remaining duration is floored.
timerFloor.v2Candidate: Represent time in milliseconds internally and define the public countdown rounding rule separately.

fallbackZeroWidth.currentBehavior: A dialogue fallback with visible log lines returns U+200B as its summary.
fallbackZeroWidth.v2Candidate: Keep summaries out of the domain engine; presentation may preserve this only for V1 compatibility.

commandMutation.currentBehavior: core applyAction overwrites action.action and action.target on the caller-owned object.
commandMutation.v2Candidate: Reject input mutation; normalize into a new command value before reduction.

directMathRandom.v2Candidate: Consume only context.random or a serializable rngState transition and record the draw in replay metadata.
